newsitem.title: USA: Colombia should buy some U.S. rice in tender - trade.
newsitem.headline: Colombia should buy some U.S. rice in tender - trade.

text.p: U.S. rice will likely be included when Colombia buys some or all of the 140,000 tonnes it has approved for import, U.S. exporters and traders said.
"At least a portion of it will be U.S.," said one U.S. rice exporter, who expects Colombia to tender soon.
Colombia's Agriculture Minister on Wednesday said permits had been issued to import 140,000 tonnes of rough rice.
Neauman Coleman, a rice trader for Dean Witter Reynolds, said a Colombian firm had already requested offers Thursday to supply 45,000 tonnes for prompt shipment.
